blurb: A focused six-fact drill set for Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Energy and Climate Technology.

topics.title: Civil engineering
topics.hook: Civil engineering designs and maintains infrastructure including roads, bridges, water systems, and buildings.
topics.explainer: Civil engineering designs and maintains infrastructure including roads, bridges, water systems, and buildings. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Energy and Climate Technology

connections.fact: Civil engineers design building systems, while LEED scores selected environmental features of completed or planned buildings.
Renewable projects require engineered foundations, roads, grids, drainage, and other civil works.

topics.title: Renewable energy
topics.hook: Renewable energy comes from sources naturally replenished on human timescales, such as sunlight and wind.
topics.explainer: Renewable energy comes from sources naturally replenished on human timescales, such as sunlight and wind. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Energy and Climate Technology

connections.fact: Solar photovoltaic power is one renewable option that converts sunlight directly into electricity.
Wind turbines and solar panels generate electricity from naturally replenished flows without burning fuel during operation.

topics.title: Solar photovoltaic
topics.hook: Solar photovoltaic cells convert sunlight directly into electricity.
topics.explainer: Solar photovoltaic cells convert sunlight directly into electricity. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Energy and Climate Technology

connections.fact: Photovoltaic cells turn sunlight into electricity and therefore sit within the wider renewable-energy category.
Solar power can run an electrolyser, allowing hydrogen to be labelled green when the electricity is renewable.

topics.title: Wind turbine
topics.hook: A wind turbine converts the kinetic energy of wind into electrical energy.
topics.explainer: A wind turbine converts the kinetic energy of wind into electrical energy. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Energy and Climate Technology

connections.fact: The turbine converts replenished wind energy into electricity without consuming the wind as a fuel.
Electricity from wind turbines can power water electrolysis used to produce green hydrogen.

topics.title: Green hydrogen
topics.hook: Green hydrogen is produced by using renewable electricity to split water through electrolysis.
topics.explainer: Green hydrogen is produced by using renewable electricity to split water through electrolysis. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Energy and Climate Technology

connections.fact: Solar photovoltaic output can power the water-splitting process that qualifies the hydrogen as green.
Wind generation is another renewable supply for electrolysers producing low-carbon hydrogen.

topics.title: LEED
topics.hook: LEED is a green-building rating system that assesses environmental performance of buildings.
topics.explainer: LEED is a green-building rating system that assesses environmental performance of buildings. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Energy and Climate Technology

connections.fact: LEED evaluates building sustainability choices that architects and civil engineers incorporate into design and construction.
On-site renewable generation can contribute to a building's environmental performance and LEED score.

questions.q: Which project falls most directly under civil engineering?
questions.explanation: Civil engineering covers the design and maintenance of structures and infrastructure such as bridges, roads, water systems, and buildings.

questions.q: Which source is naturally replenished on a human timescale?
questions.explanation: Sunlight is continuously replenished and supports solar generation, unlike finite fossil-fuel deposits formed over geological time.

questions.q: What conversion occurs inside a solar photovoltaic cell?
options: Chemical fuel to heat and then electricity
questions.explanation: Photovoltaic materials produce an electric current when illuminated, avoiding a mechanical turbine in the direct conversion step.

questions.q: A rotor turns because moving air has kinetic energy. What output does the generator produce?
options: Mechanical energy stored only in the blades
Chemical energy in a fuel tank
questions.explanation: The rotor and drive train convert wind motion into mechanical rotation, and the generator converts that rotation into electricity.

questions.q: Which production route qualifies hydrogen as green?
questions.explanation: Green hydrogen is made by splitting water in an electrolyser whose electricity comes from renewable generation.
LEED is a green-building rating framework covering areas such as energy, water, materials, sites, and indoor environmental quality.

questions.q: How can civil engineering enable a wind farm?
options: By designing foundations, roads, and grid-related works
By designing the blade aerodynamics and rotor profile
By forecasting wind speed for daily market bids
questions.explanation: Turbines require substantial engineered foundations, access infrastructure, drainage, and connections before electrical generation can operate safely.

questions.q: A solar array powers an electrolyser. What product connects the two topics?
questions.explanation: Renewable solar electricity can split water into hydrogen and oxygen, making the resulting hydrogen a green fuel feedstock.

questions.q: Which comparison correctly distinguishes solar power from wind power?
options: Solar PV converts light; wind turbines convert moving air
Solar PV and wind turbines both require fuel combustion in the generator
Wind turbines convert sunlight directly while solar panels convert air motion
Solar PV produces mechanical shaft rotation before generating electricity
questions.explanation: Solar cells use the photovoltaic effect, whereas turbines first capture wind's kinetic energy through rotating blades.

questions.q: A building earns a sustainability rating. Which claim would be a trap?
options: Renewable energy may contribute to credits
Civil engineers may help implement rated features
questions.explanation: LEED measures and certifies design outcomes; it is a rating system, not a technology that produces power.
